question: Where did the Prime Minister inaugurate the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Institute of Archaeology in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Greater Noida.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister inaugurates the **Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Institute of Archaeology** at **Greater Noida in Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The Institute's aims is to provide a supportive and enthusiastic academic atmosphere to help students achieve their full potential in the field of archaeology.
 
• “The institute will provide modern amenities for research scholars and students from India and also from all over the world."
 
• The institute was inaugurated on **9 March 2019**.
